CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Autumn-2025 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Autumn-2025 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,422 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 5 benchmark sites in 4 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: March 2025 to March 2025). These surveys captured 8 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 13 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 982 cards across 92 sites, with 3.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (38 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 408 transects across 95 sites (survey period: February 2025 to May 2025), detecting active burrows in 3.4% of transects (total: 20 active burrows).
